description: Source code for a command-line utility handling date and time operations, including formatting, parsing, and timestamp calculations.

methods.name: show_relative_dates
methods.description: Displays dates relative to current time based on input timestamps.

methods.name: show_human_dates
methods.description: Displays human-readable date formats for input timestamps.

methods.name: show_dates
methods.description: Displays formatted dates based on specified format and timestamps.

methods.name: parse_dates
methods.description: Parses date strings into timestamps and displays them in ISO8601 format.

methods.name: parse_approxidate
methods.description: Parses approximate date strings into timestamps.

methods.name: parse_approx_timestamp
methods.description: Parses approximate date strings into timestamps and displays raw timestamp values.

methods.name: getnanos
methods.description: Retrieves current nanotime and optionally subtracts a specified start value.

methods.name: cmd__date
methods.description: Main command handler for 'date' subcommands, dispatching to specific functions based on arguments.
